sentences.zh: 開元大衍曆演紀上元閼逢困敦之歲，距開元十二年甲子，積九千六百九十六萬一千七百四十算。

translations.literal: The Kaiyuan Dayan calendar evolving-era computation: the high origin in the year Yān-féng Kùn-dūn; counting back from Kaiyuan 12, year jiazi, the accumulated count is 96,961,740.
translations.idiomatic: In computing the evolving era of the Kaiyuan Dayan calendar, the high origin falls in the year Yān-féng Kùn-dūn; reckoned back from Kaiyuan 12 (jiazi), the accumulated count is 96,961,740.

translations.literal: Section One: Method for pacing central qi and new moons
translations.idiomatic: I. Method for Determining Central Qi and New Moons

sentences.zh: 策實百一十一萬三百四十三。
揲法八萬九千七百七十三。
策餘萬五千九百四十三。
用差萬七千一百二十四。
三元之策十五，餘六百六十四，秒七。
四象之策二十九，餘千六百一十三。
中盈分千三百二十八，秒十四。
以策實乘積算，曰中積分。

translations.literal: Multiply accumulated counts by stalk substance; call it central accumulated parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the era count by the year-fraction constant to obtain the central accumulated parts.

translations.literal: Divide by universal method to obtain one; this is accumulated days.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the universal divisor; the quotient is accumulated days.

sentences.zh: 爻數去之，餘起甲子算外，得天正中氣。

translations.literal: Remove by line number; from the remainder count outward from jiazi, obtain the heavenly central qi.
translations.idiomatic: Remove full cycles of sixty lines; from the remainder, counting outward from jiazi, obtain the celestial central qi.

translations.literal: The parts become minor remainder; the days become major remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The fractional parts become the minor remainder; the days become the major remainder.

translations.literal: Add three-origin stalks to obtain the next qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add the three-origin interval to obtain the next qi.

sentences.zh: 凡率相因加者，下有餘秒，皆以類相從。

translations.literal: Whenever rates are linked by addition, if below there are remainder parts, all follow their kind together.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever linked rates are added and fractional remainders remain below, combine them by kind.

translations.literal: When full, advance stepwise through the method, adding to the upper position.
translations.idiomatic: When a divisor is filled, carry upward step by step and add to the higher place.

translations.literal: Remove by line number when days overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full cycles of sixty when days overflow.

sentences.zh: 以揲法去中積分，不盡曰歸餘之掛。

translations.literal: Remove central accumulated parts by sorting method; what does not exhaust is called the pendulum of returned remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the central accumulated parts by the new-moon constant; the remainder is the intercalation pendulum.

translations.literal: Subtract from central accumulated parts to obtain new-moon accumulated parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract that amount from the central accumulated parts to obtain the new-moon accumulated parts.

sentences.zh: 如通法為日，去命如前，得天正經朔。

translations.literal: Take as days per universal method; remove the era as before to obtain the canonical new moon of the heavenly standard.
translations.idiomatic: Convert by the universal divisor into days; fix the era as before to obtain the canonical winter new moon.

sentences.zh: 加一象之日七、餘千一百六十三少，得上弦。

translations.literal: Add one image’s days, seven, remainder 1,163 and less, to obtain first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Add one four-image interval—seven days, remainder 1,163 lesser—to obtain the first quarter.

translations.literal: Double it to obtain full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain full moon.

translations.literal: Triple it to obtain last quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Triple it to obtain last quarter.

sentences.zh: 四之，是謂一揲，得後月朔。

translations.literal: Quadruple it; this is called one sorting, obtaining the next month’s new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Quadruple it—one full sorting—to obtain the next month’s new moon.

translations.literal: Of every four parts, one is “less,” three are “greater.”
translations.idiomatic: In quartering remainders, one part is “lesser,” three are “greater.”

sentences.zh: 綜中盈、朔虛分，累益歸餘之掛，每其月閏衰。

translations.literal: Combine central surplus and new-moon void fractions, cumulatively increasing the returned-remainder pendulum; each month the intercalation wanes.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the central surplus and new-moon void fractions, steadily increasing the intercalation pendulum; each month the intercalation fraction diminishes.

sentences.zh: 凡歸餘之掛五萬六千七百六十以上，其歲有閏。

translations.literal: Whenever the returned-remainder pendulum is 56,760 or above, that year has an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the intercalation pendulum reaches 56,760 or more, the year receives an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 因考其閏衰，滿掛限以上，其月合置閏。

translations.literal: Examining its intercalation wane, when full above the pendulum limit, that month should receive intercalation.
translations.idiomatic: Track the intercalation wane; when it exceeds the intercalation threshold, assign an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 或以進退，皆以定朔無中氣裁焉。

translations.literal: Whether advancing or retreating, all are trimmed by the fixed new moon without central qi.
translations.idiomatic: Whether advancing or retreating, the rule is the fixed new moon in a month without central qi.

sentences.zh: 凡常氣小餘不滿通法、如中盈分之半已下者，以象統乘之，內秒分，參而伍之，以減策實；

translations.literal: Whenever for a regular qi the minor remainder does not fill the universal method and is half the central surplus fraction or below, multiply by the image cycle, include parts and seconds, combine and quintuple, and subtract from stalk substance;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a regular qi’s minor remainder is less than the universal divisor and no more than half the central surplus fraction, multiply by the image cycle, include seconds, combine and quintuple, and subtract from the stalk substance;

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, take as days per stalk remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by the stalk remainder, gives the days.

sentences.zh: 命常氣初日算外，得沒日。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from the first day of regular qi; obtain the extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the first day of the regular qi; the result is the extinction day.

sentences.zh: 凡經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者，以小餘減通法，餘倍參伍乘之，用減滅法；

translations.literal: Whenever for a canonical new moon the minor remainder does not fill the new-moon void fraction, subtract the minor remainder from the universal method; multiply the remainder by double quintuple;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a canonical new moon’s minor remainder is less than the new-moon void fraction, subtract the minor remainder from the universal divisor; double and quintuple the remainder;

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, take as days per new-moon void fraction.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by the new-moon void fraction, gives the days.

sentences.zh: 命經朔初日算外，得滅日。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from the first day of canonical new moon; obtain the extinguishing day.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the first day of the canonical new moon; the result is the lunar extinguishing day.

translations.literal: Section Two: Method for issuing and gathering in
translations.idiomatic: II. Method for Issuing and Gathering In

sentences.zh: 天中之策五，餘二百二十一，秒三十一；

translations.idiomatic: Heaven-central interval: five stalks, remainder 221, 31 parts;

sentences.zh: 地中之策六，餘二百六十五，秒八十六；

translations.idiomatic: Earth-central interval: six stalks, remainder 265, 86 parts;

sentences.zh: 貞悔之策三，餘百三十二，秒百三。

translations.idiomatic: Zhen-hui interval: three stalks, remainder 132, 103 parts.

translations.literal: For each, fix by the mid-node of the central qi; obtain the first hou.
translations.idiomatic: For each, start from the mid-node of the central qi; obtain the first phenological hou.

translations.literal: Add heaven-central stalks to obtain the next hou.
translations.idiomatic: Add the heaven-central interval to obtain the next hou.

translations.literal: Add again to obtain the last hou.
translations.idiomatic: Add again to obtain the last hou.

sentences.zh: 因中氣命之，得公卦用事。

translations.literal: Fix by central qi; obtain the duke hexagram’s governing period.
translations.idiomatic: Fix from the central qi; obtain when the duke hexagram governs.

sentences.zh: 以地中之策累加之，得次卦，若以貞悔之策加侯卦，得十有二節之初外卦用事。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add earth-central stalks to obtain the next hexagram; or add zhen-hui stalks to the marquis hexagram to obtain when the outer hexagram of the twelve nodes governs.
translations.idiomatic: Keep adding the earth-central interval for successive hexagrams; or add the zhen-hui interval to the marquis hexagram to obtain when the outer hexagram of the twelve nodes governs.

sentences.zh: 因四立命之，得春木、夏火、秋金、冬水用事。

translations.literal: Fix by the four establishments; obtain when spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water govern.
translations.idiomatic: Fix from the four establishment days; obtain when spring Wood, summer Fire, autumn Metal, and winter Water govern.

sentences.zh: 以貞悔之策減季月中氣，得土王用事。

translations.literal: Subtract zhen-hui stalks from the central qi of the last month of the season; obtain when Earth the King governs.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the zhen-hui interval from the last seasonal month’s central qi; obtain when Earth the King governs.

sentences.zh: 凡相加減而秒母不齊，當令母互乘子，乃加減之；

translations.literal: Whenever adding or subtracting and the second denominators are not equal, let the denominators cross-multiply the numerators, then add or subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever addition or subtraction leaves unequal fractional denominators, cross-multiply numerators by the opposite denominators, then add or subtract;

translations.literal: Denominators multiplied together form the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: The product of denominators is the common divisor.

sentences.zh: 各以通法約其月閏衰，為日，得中氣去經朔日算。

translations.literal: For each, reduce the month’s intercalation wane by the universal method to obtain days, and get the day-count from central qi to canonical new moon.
translations.idiomatic: For each month, divide the intercalation wane by the universal divisor to obtain days, yielding the interval from central qi to canonical new moon.

sentences.zh: 求卦、候者，各以天、地之策，累加減之。

translations.literal: To seek hexagrams and hou, for each cumulatively add or subtract heaven- and earth-central stalks.
translations.idiomatic: To determine hexagrams and phenological hou, cumulatively add or subtract the heaven- and earth-central intervals.

sentences.zh: 凡發斂加時，各置其小餘，以六爻乘之，如辰法而一，為半辰之數。

translations.literal: Whenever issuing and gathering in with time, set the minor remainder for each; multiply by six lines; take one per chronogram method as the half-chronogram number.
translations.idiomatic: When fixing the time of issuing and gathering in, set each minor remainder, multiply by six lines, and divide by the chronogram divisor to obtain the half-chronogram count.

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, reduce by three to obtain parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by three, gives fractional parts.

translations.literal: When parts fill the clepsydra method, they become clepsydra marks.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the clepsydra divisor, they become clepsydra notches.

sentences.zh: 若令滿象積為刻者，即置不盡之數，十之，十九而一，為分。

translations.literal: If one lets the image accumulation fill the clepsydra marks, set the unexhausted number, multiply by ten, and one per nineteen becomes parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the image accumulation is to fill clepsydra marks directly, take the remainder, multiply by ten, and divide by nineteen for the parts.

translations.literal: Fix the chronogram starting from zi half, outward from the count.
translations.idiomatic: Fix the chronogram from the half-period of zi, counting outward from the tally.

translations.literal: Section Three: Method for pacing solar motion
translations.idiomatic: III. Method for Determining Solar Motion

sentences.zh: 乾實百一十一萬三百七十九太。
周天度三百六十五，虛分七百七十九太。

translations.literal: Circuit-of-heaven degrees 365, void fraction 779 and greater.
translations.idiomatic: Degrees in the circuit of heaven: 365, void fraction 779 and greater.

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分盈減、縮加三元之策，為定氣所有日及餘。

translations.literal: With expansion–contraction fractions, where expansion subtract and contraction add to the three-origin tally, obtain the days and remainder belonging to fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion–contraction fractions: subtract where expansion and add where contraction from the three-origin tally, yielding the days and remainder for fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 乃十二乘日，又三其小餘，辰法約而一，從之，為定氣辰數。

translations.literal: Then multiply the days by twelve, triple the minor remainder, reduce by one per chronogram divisor and add, obtaining the fixed-qi chronogram count.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the days by twelve, triple the minor remainder, divide by the chronogram divisor and add the quotient, to obtain the fixed-qi chronogram count.

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, multiply by ten and reduce again to obtain parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, multiplied by ten and reduced again, gives fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 以所入氣幷後氣盈縮分，倍六爻乘之，綜兩氣辰數除之，為末率。

translations.literal: Take the expansion–contraction fractions of the entered qi together with the following qi, double and multiply by six lines, divide by the combined chronogram counts of both qi, obtaining the terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the expansion–contraction fractions of the current and next qi, double and multiply by six lines, divide by the sum of their chronogram counts, and obtain the terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 又列二氣盈縮分，皆倍六爻乘之，各如辰數而一；

translations.literal: Again set out the expansion–contraction fractions of both qi; each is doubled and multiplied by six lines, and one per chronogram count is taken.
translations.idiomatic: Set out both qi’s expansion–contraction fractions, each doubled and multiplied by six lines, and divide each by its chronogram count.

translations.literal: Subtract the smaller from the larger; the remainder is the qi difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the smaller from the larger; the remainder is the qi difference.

sentences.zh: 至後以差加末率，分後以差減末率，為初率。

translations.literal: After the solstice add the difference to the terminal rate; after the equinox subtract the difference from the terminal rate, obtaining the initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: After a solstice, add the difference to the terminal rate; after an equinox, subtract it—this yields the initial rate.

sentences.zh: 倍氣差，亦倍六爻乘之，復綜兩氣辰數除，為日差。

translations.literal: Double the qi difference, likewise double and multiply by six lines, again divide by the combined chronogram counts of both qi, obtaining the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the qi difference, double and multiply by six lines, divide again by the combined chronogram counts of both qi, and obtain the day difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，以加減初末，各為定率。

translations.literal: Halve it and add or subtract from initial and terminal rates; each becomes a fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the day difference and add or subtract from the initial and terminal rates to obtain the fixed rates.

sentences.zh: 以日差至後以減、分後以加氣初定率，為每日盈縮分。

translations.literal: With the day difference, after the solstice subtract from and after the equinox add to the initial fixed rate of the qi, obtaining the daily expansion–contraction fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Using the day difference, subtract from the initial fixed rate after a solstice and add after an equinox, yielding the daily expansion–contraction fraction.

sentences.zh: 乃馴積之，隨所入氣日加減氣下先後數，各其日定數。

translations.literal: Then accumulate evenly; day by day within the entered qi add or subtract the lead and lag numbers below the qi, each day’s fixed tally.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate stepwise: for each day within the entered qi, add or subtract the lead and lag counts listed under that qi to obtain each day’s fixed tally.

translations.literal: To seek waxing and waning accumulations, follow this same method.
translations.idiomatic: To determine waxing and waning accumulations, follow the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 冬至後為陽復，在盈加之，在縮減之；

translations.literal: After the Winter Solstice is yang recovery: where expansion, add; where contraction, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter Solstice is yang recovery: add in expansion and subtract in contraction.

sentences.zh: 夏至後為陰復，在縮加之，在盈減之。

translations.literal: After the Summer Solstice is yin recovery: where contraction, add; where expansion, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the Summer Solstice is yin recovery: add in contraction and subtract in expansion.

sentences.zh: 距四正前一氣，在陰陽變革之際，不可相幷，皆因前末為初率。

translations.literal: One qi before each of the four cardinal points, at the turn of yin and yang, cannot be combined; therefore take the prior terminal as the initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: For the qi immediately before each cardinal solstice or equinox, at the yin–yang transition the rates cannot be merged; use the prior qi’s terminal rate as the initial rate.

sentences.zh: 以氣差至前加之，分前減之，為末率。

translations.literal: Before the solstice add the difference; before the equinox subtract the difference, obtaining the terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Before a solstice add the difference to obtain the terminal rate; before an equinox subtract it.

translations.literal: For the remainder, follow the prior method; each sought value is thereby obtained.
translations.idiomatic: For the rest, follow the method above; each quantity sought is thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 其分不滿全數，母又每氣不同，當退法除之。

translations.literal: When the parts do not fill the whole number and the denominators differ for each qi, the divisor must be reduced accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: When fractional parts do not make a full unit and each qi has a different denominator, reduce by retreating the divisor.

sentences.zh: 以百為母，半已上，收成一。

translations.literal: Take one hundred as the denominator; at half or above, collect into one.
translations.idiomatic: Use one hundred as the denominator; at one-half or above, round up to one.

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至偕得天地之中，無有盈縮。

translations.literal: Winter and Summer Solstices alike attain the heaven–earth mean; there is no expansion or contraction.
translations.idiomatic: At the Winter and Summer Solstices alike the sun reaches the cosmological mean; there is neither expansion nor contraction.

sentences.zh: 餘各以氣下先後數先減、後加常氣小餘，滿若不足，進退其日，得定大小餘。

translations.literal: For the rest, with the lead and lag numbers below each qi first subtract and then add to the minor remainder of regular qi; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day, obtaining fixed major and minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: For the remaining qi, first subtract then add the lead and lag counts under each qi to the regular qi’s minor remainder; carry or borrow days as needed to obtain fixed major and minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 凡推日月度及軌漏、交蝕，依定氣；

translations.literal: For all computations of solar and lunar degrees, orbital motion and clepsydra, and eclipses, rely on fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: All calculations of solar and lunar longitude, orbital motion, clepsydra marks, and eclipses use fixed qi.

translations.literal: For calendar entries, rely on regular qi.

sentences.zh: 以減經朔、弦、望，各其所入日算。

translations.literal: Subtract to obtain canonical new moon, quarter, and full moon, each its entered day count.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the canonical new, quarter, and full moons by each entered day count.

sentences.zh: 若大餘不足減，加爻數，乃減之。

translations.literal: If the major remainder is insufficient to subtract, add the line count, then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the major remainder is too small to subtract, add sixty lines, then subtract.

sentences.zh: 減所入定氣日算一，各以日差乘而半之；

translations.literal: Subtract one from the entered fixed-qi day count; multiply each by the day difference and halve.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one from the entered fixed-qi day count, multiply by the day difference, and halve.

sentences.zh: 前少以加、前多以減氣初定率，以乘其所入定氣日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: If the prior is less, add; if the prior is more, subtract from the initial fixed rate of the qi; multiply by the entered fixed-qi day count, remainder, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior fraction is smaller, add; if larger, subtract from the qi’s initial fixed rate; then multiply by the entered fixed-qi day count, remainder, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 凡除者，先以母通全，內子，乃相乘；

translations.literal: For all divisions, first convert wholes through the denominator and include the numerator, then multiply.
translations.idiomatic: In every division, first unify whole units through the denominator, include the numerator, then multiply.
Multiply and divide by the denominators.

sentences.zh: 所得以損益朓朒積，各其入朓朒定數。

translations.literal: What is obtained is used to increase or decrease the waxing–waning accumulation, each its entered waxing–waning fixed tally.
translations.idiomatic: Use the result to adjust the waxing–waning accumulation, obtaining each entered waxing–waning fixed tally.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交者，以十二乘所入日算；

translations.literal: If it is not a syzygy with an eclipse at new or full moon, multiply the entered day count by twelve.
translations.idiomatic: When new or full moon is not an eclipse syzygy, multiply the entered day count by twelve.

sentences.zh: 三其小餘，辰法除而從之；

translations.literal: Triple the minor remainder; divide by the chronogram method and add it;
translations.idiomatic: Triple the minor remainder, divide by the chronogram divisor, and add the quotient;

sentences.zh: 以乘損益率，如定氣辰數而一。

translations.literal: Multiply by the increase-decrease rate; take one per fixed-qi chronogram count.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the rate of increase or decrease, and divide by the fixed-qi chronogram count.

sentences.zh: 所得以損益朓朒積，各為定數。

translations.literal: Apply the result to increase or decrease the fast-slow accumulation; each becomes a fixed count.
translations.idiomatic: Use the result to adjust the anomalistic accumulation, yielding a fixed value for each entry.

sentences.zh: 南斗二十六，牛八，婺女十二，虛十，虛分七百七十九太。

translations.literal: Southern Dipper 26, Ox 8, Maid 12, Emptiness 10, Emptiness fraction 779 and greater.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Dipper: 26°; Ox: 8°; Maid: 12°; Emptiness: 10°, void fraction 779 and greater.

sentences.zh: 危十七，營室十六，東壁九，奎十六，婁十二，胃十四，昴十一，畢十七，觜觿一，參十，東井三十三，輿鬼三，柳十五，七星七，張十八，翼十八，軫十七，角十二，亢九，氐十五，房五，心五，尾十八，箕十一，為赤道度。

translations.literal: Rooftop 17, Encampment 16, Eastern Wall 9, Stride 16, Bond 12, Stomach 14, Hairy Head 11, Net 17, Turtle Beak 1, Three Stars 10, Eastern Well 33, Ghost Cart 3, Willow 15, Seven Stars 7, Extended Net 18, Wings 18, Chariot Shaft 17, Horn 12, Neck 9, Root 15, Room 5, Heart 5, Tail 18, Winnowing Basket 11 — these are equatorial degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop 17°, Encampment 16°, Eastern Wall 9°, Stride 16°, Bond 12°, Stomach 14°, Hairy Head 11°, Net 17°, Turtle Beak 1°, Three Stars 10°, Eastern Well 33°, Ghost Cart 3°, Willow 15°, Seven Stars 7°, Extended Net 18°, Wings 18°, Chariot Shaft 17°, Horn 12°, Neck 9°, Root 15°, Room 5°, Heart 5°, Tail 18°, Winnowing Basket 11° — the equatorial lodge degrees.

sentences.zh: 其畢、觜觿、參、輿鬼四宿度數，與古不同。

translations.literal: The degree-counts of the four lodges Net, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Ghost Cart differ from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The arc-degrees assigned to Net, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Ghost Cart differ from the ancient reckoning.

sentences.zh: 依天以儀測定，用為常數。

translations.literal: Measured by instrument according to heaven, these are taken as constants.
translations.idiomatic: They were fixed by armillary measurement against the sky and adopted as standard constants.

sentences.zh: 紘帶天中，儀極攸憑，以格黃道。

translations.literal: The girdle spans heaven’s center; the instrument’s pole is relied upon to mark off the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial girdle runs through heaven’s center; the polar axis of the instrument is the reference for laying out the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 推冬至歲差所在，每距冬至前後各五度為限，初數十二，每限減一。

translations.literal: To determine the seat of the winter-solstice annual difference: each five degrees before and after the winter solstice is one limit; the initial count is twelve; each limit reduces by one.
translations.idiomatic: To find where the winter-solstice precession applies: take five degrees on either side of the solstice as one band; begin at twelve and subtract one for each successive band.

translations.literal: Through nine limits the count ends at four.
translations.idiomatic: After nine bands the tally reaches four.

sentences.zh: 當二立之際，一度少強，依平。

translations.literal: At the two “Establishment” nodes, one degree slightly strong, follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the two Establishment qi, treat one degree as slightly strong and use the mean value.

sentences.zh: 乃距春分前、秋分後，初限起四，每限增一，盡九限，終於十二，而黃道交復。

translations.literal: Then from before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, the initial limit begins at four; each limit adds one; through nine limits it ends at twelve, and the ecliptic intersection returns.
translations.idiomatic: From before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, begin the first band at four and add one per band; after nine bands the tally is twelve, and the ecliptic obliquity cycle completes.

sentences.zh: 計春分後、秋分前，亦五度為限。

translations.literal: Count likewise after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, again with five degrees per limit.
translations.idiomatic: For the interval after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, use the same five-degree bands.

sentences.zh: 初數十二，盡九限，數終於四。

translations.literal: The initial count is twelve; through nine limits the count ends at four.
translations.idiomatic: Begin at twelve; after nine bands the tally reaches four.

sentences.zh: 當二立之際，一度少強，依平。

translations.literal: At the two “Establishment” nodes, one degree slightly strong, follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the two Establishment qi, treat one degree as slightly strong and use the mean value.

sentences.zh: 乃距夏至前後，初限起四，盡九限，終於十二。

translations.literal: Then before and after the summer solstice, the initial limit begins at four; through nine limits it ends at twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after the summer solstice, begin the first band at four; after nine bands the tally is twelve.

sentences.zh: 皆累裁之，以數乘限度，百二十而一，得度。

translations.literal: Trim cumulatively in each case; multiply the limit-count by the band-number; divide by 120 to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the trims in order, multiply the band index by the limit value, and divide by 120 to obtain degrees.

translations.literal: What does not fill, divide by twelve for parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by twelve, gives fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 若以十除，則大分，十二為母，命太、半、少及強、弱。

translations.literal: If one divides by ten, the major parts take twelve as denominator; name greater, half, lesser, and strong or weak.
translations.idiomatic: If divided by ten instead, use twelve as the denominator for major parts, naming greater, half, lesser, strong, and weak fractions.

translations.literal: Name it the yellow–red path difference number.
translations.idiomatic: This is called the ecliptic–equator difference.

sentences.zh: 二至前後各九限，以差減赤道度，二分前後各九限，以差加赤道度，各為黃道度。

translations.literal: For nine limits before and after each solstice, subtract the difference from equatorial degrees; for nine limits before and after each equinox, add the difference to equatorial degrees — each yields ecliptic degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Within nine bands on either side of each solstice, subtract the difference from the equatorial longitude; within nine bands on either side of each equinox, add it — yielding ecliptic longitude in each case.

sentences.zh: 開元十二年，南斗二十三半，牛七半，婺女十一少，虛十，六虛之差十九太。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan 12: Southern Dipper 23½, Ox 7½, Maid 11 lesser, Emptiness 10, six Emptiness differences 19 greater.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan year 12: Southern Dipper 23½°, Ox 7½°, Maid 11° lesser, Emptiness 10°, six Emptiness-difference parts 19 greater.

sentences.zh: 危十七太，營室十七少，東壁九太，奎十七半，婁十二太，胃十四太，昴十一，畢十六少，觜觿一，參九少，東井三十，輿鬼二太，柳十四少，七星六太，張十八太，翼十九少，軫十八太，角十三，亢九半，氐十五太，房五，心四太，尾十七，箕十少，為黃道度，以步日行。

translations.literal: Rooftop 17 greater, Encampment 17 lesser, Eastern Wall 9 greater, Stride 17½, Bond 12 greater, Stomach 14 greater, Hairy Head 11, Net 16 lesser, Turtle Beak 1, Three Stars 9 lesser, Eastern Well 30, Ghost Cart 2 greater, Willow 14 lesser, Seven Stars 6 greater, Extended Net 18 greater, Wings 19 lesser, Chariot Shaft 18 greater, Horn 13, Neck 9½, Root 15 greater, Room 5, Heart 4 greater, Tail 17, Winnowing Basket 10 lesser — these are ecliptic degrees for pacing the sun’s daily motion.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop 17° greater, Encampment 17° lesser, Eastern Wall 9° greater, Stride 17½°, Bond 12° greater, Stomach 14° greater, Hairy Head 11°, Net 16° lesser, Turtle Beak 1°, Three Stars 9° lesser, Eastern Well 30°, Ghost Cart 2° greater, Willow 14° lesser, Seven Stars 6° greater, Extended Net 18° greater, Wings 19° lesser, Chariot Shaft 18° greater, Horn 13°, Neck 9½°, Root 15° greater, Room 5°, Heart 4° greater, Tail 17°, Winnowing Basket 10° lesser — the ecliptic lodge degrees used to pace the sun’s daily course.

translations.literal: The moon and the five planets enter and exit according to this.
translations.idiomatic: The moon and the five planets are reckoned by the same ecliptic framework.

sentences.zh: 求此宿度，皆有餘分，前後輩之成少、半、太，準為全度。

translations.literal: In seeking these lodge degrees, all have surplus parts; earlier and later generations round them to lesser, half, or greater, aligning them to whole degrees.
translations.idiomatic: These lodge longitudes all carry fractional remainders; successive reckonings round them to lesser, half, or greater parts to align with whole degrees.

sentences.zh: 若上考往古，下驗將來，當據歲差，每移一度，各依術算，使得當時度分，然後可以步三辰矣。

translations.literal: If one examines antiquity above and tests the future below, one should follow the annual difference and, for each degree it shifts, compute by the method so as to obtain the degrees and parts of that time — only then can one pace the Three Luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: To verify against past ages and test future ones, apply the precession: for each degree of shift, recalculate by the method to obtain contemporary longitudes — only then may one pace the sun, moon, and planets.

translations.literal: Subtract circuit-of-heaven substance from the central accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the circuit-of-heaven constant from the central accumulation;

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, fill the universal method to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by the universal divisor, gives degrees.

sentences.zh: 命起赤道虛九，宿次去之，經虛去分，至不滿宿算外，得冬至加時日度。

translations.literal: Fix the count from equatorial Emptiness 9; remove lodge by lodge, passing Emptiness and subtracting its fraction, until less than one lodge remains outside the count — obtaining the winter-solstice hour-added solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Count from equatorial Emptiness 9°, subtracting whole lodges and the Emptiness fraction in turn, until less than one lodge remains beyond the tally — this yields the solar longitude at winter-solstice hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 以三元之策累加之，得次氣加時日度。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add the three-origin interval to obtain the hour-added solar degree for each successive qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add the three-origin interval repeatedly to obtain the hour-added solar degree for each successive qi.

translations.literal: Subtract the degree remainder from the universal method;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the degree remainder from the universal divisor;

sentences.zh: 餘以冬至日躔距度所入限數乘之，為距前分。

translations.literal: Multiply the remainder by the limit-number of the winter-solstice solar station’s distance-degree entry to obtain the pre-distance fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the band index for the winter-solstice solar station’s distance entry to obtain the pre-distance fraction.

sentences.zh: 置距度下黃赤道差，以通法乘之，減去距前分；

translations.literal: Set the yellow–red path difference below the distance degree; multiply by the universal method and subtract the pre-distance fraction;
translations.idiomatic: Take the ecliptic–equator difference for the distance band, multiply by the universal divisor, and subtract the pre-distance fraction;

translations.literal: Divide the remainder by 120 when full to obtain the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder fills 120, divide to obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，以象統乘之，復除，為秒分。

translations.literal: What does not fill, multiply by the image cycle and divide again for seconds and parts.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not fill, multiply by the image cycle and divide again to obtain seconds and parts.

sentences.zh: 乃以定差減赤道宿度，得冬至加時黃道日度。

translations.literal: Then subtract the fixed difference from the equatorial lodge degree to obtain the ecliptic solar degree at winter-solstice hour-addition.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the fixed difference from the equatorial lodge longitude to obtain the ecliptic solar degree at winter-solstice hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 又置歲差，以限數乘之，滿百二十除，為秒分。

translations.literal: Also set the annual difference; multiply by the limit-number; divide by 120 for seconds and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the annual precession, multiply by the band index, and divide by 120 for seconds and parts.

translations.literal: What does not exhaust becomes minor parts.

sentences.zh: 以加三元之策，因累裁之。

translations.literal: Add to the three-origin interval and trim cumulatively.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the three-origin interval and accumulate the trims in order.

sentences.zh: 命以黃道宿次，各得定氣加時日度。

translations.literal: Fix the count by ecliptic lodge sequence; each yields the hour-added solar degree for fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Count through the ecliptic lodges in sequence to obtain the hour-added solar degree for each fixed qi.

translations.literal: Set the fixed minor remainder for that qi and keep a duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed minor remainder for that qi and keep a duplicate tally.

sentences.zh: 以乘其日盈縮分，滿通法而一，盈加、縮減其副。

translations.literal: Multiply by its daily surplus-deficit fraction; divide by the universal method; surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by its daily equation of time, divide by the universal divisor, and add or subtract from the duplicate according to surplus or deficit.

sentences.zh: 用減其日加時度餘，得其夜半日度。

translations.literal: Use this to subtract from the hour-added degree remainder for that day; obtain the midnight solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the day’s hour-added degree remainder to obtain the solar longitude at midnight.

sentences.zh: 因累加一策，以其日盈縮分盈加、縮減度餘，得每日夜半日度。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add one interval; with each day’s surplus-deficit fraction, surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the degree remainder — obtaining the midnight solar degree for each day.
translations.idiomatic: Add one interval at each step; apply each day’s equation to the degree remainder by addition or subtraction — yielding the midnight solar degree day by day.

translations.literal: Section Four: Method for pacing lunar motion
translations.idiomatic: IV. Method for Determining Lunar Motion

sentences.zh: 轉終六百七十萬一千二百七十九。
轉終日二十七，餘千六百八十五，秒七十九。
以秒法乘朔積分，盈轉終去之；

translations.literal: Multiply new-moon accumulation by the second method; remove what fills the rotation cycle;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the new-moon accumulation by the second divisor and cast out full rotation cycles;

sentences.zh: 餘復以秒法約，為入轉分；

translations.literal: Reduce the remainder again by the second method to obtain rotation entry parts;
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the remainder again by the second divisor to obtain rotation entry parts;

translations.literal: When it fills the universal method, that makes days.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the universal divisor, they become days.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，得天正經朔加時所入。

translations.literal: Fix the count outside the day-tally; obtain the entry at canonical new moon of the celestial first month, hour-added.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the day tally to obtain the rotation entry at the hour-added canonical new moon of the celestial first month.

sentences.zh: 因加轉差日一、餘二千九百六十七、秒一，得次朔。

translations.literal: Then add rotation difference: one day, remainder 2,967, second 1 — obtaining the next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add the rotation increment of one day, remainder 2,967, and one second to obtain the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 以一象之策，循變相加，得弦、望。

translations.literal: With one four-image interval, change and add in sequence to obtain first and last quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Add one four-image interval in turn to obtain the first and last quarters.

sentences.zh: 盈轉終日及餘秒者，去之。

translations.literal: When days and remainder-seconds fill the rotation cycle, remove them.
translations.idiomatic: When days and remainder-seconds fill the rotation cycle, cast them out.

sentences.zh: 各以經朔、弦、望小餘減之，得其日夜半所入。

translations.literal: For each, subtract the new-moon, quarter, or full-moon minor remainder to obtain the entry at that night’s midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each new-moon, quarter, or full-moon minor remainder to obtain the rotation entry at that night’s midnight.
Initial increase rate: 48, terminal decrease rate: 6

sentences.zh: 初損二百三十一末益六十六

translations.idiomatic: Initial decrease rate: 231, terminal increase rate: 66

sentences.zh: 二百四十三度四十九分
二百五十七度四十四分
二百七十一度二十五分

translations.idiomatic: Initial increase rate: 36, terminal decrease rate: 18

sentences.zh: 二百八十四度六十五分
三百三十六度五十七分
三百六十一度四十四分
初損百六十五末益入後

translations.literal: Initial decrease 165, terminal increase enters thereafter
translations.idiomatic: Initial decrease rate: 165, terminal increase rate enters thereafter

sentences.zh: 各置朔、弦、望所入轉日損益率，幷後率而半之，為通率。

translations.literal: For each, set the increase-decrease rates for the rotation days entered at new, quarter, and full moon; combine the following rate and halve them as the universal rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each syzygy, set the increase-decrease rates for the entered rotation days at new, quarter, and full moon; average them with the following rate to obtain the universal rate.

translations.literal: Again subtract the two rates; the difference is the rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two rates; the remainder is the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 前多者，以入餘減通法，餘乘率差，盈通法得一，幷率差而半之；

translations.literal: If the prior is greater, subtract the entry remainder from the universal method, multiply the remainder by the rate difference, and when full of the universal method take one; halve together with the rate difference;
translations.idiomatic: If the prior rate is larger, subtract the entry remainder from the universal divisor, multiply the remainder by the rate difference, divide by the universal divisor and round up, then halve together with the rate difference;

sentences.zh: 前少者，半入餘，乘率差，亦以通法除之：為加時轉率。

translations.literal: If the prior is smaller, halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference, and likewise divide by the universal method: this is the hour-added rotation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior rate is smaller, halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference, and divide by the universal divisor likewise: this yields the hour-added rotation rate.

sentences.zh: 乃半之，以損益加時所入，餘為轉餘。

translations.literal: Then halve it and increase or decrease what is entered at the hour; the remainder is the rotation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Halve this and apply increase or decrease to the hour entry; the remainder is the rotation remainder.

translations.literal: For the rotation remainder, where increase is due, subtract from the method;
translations.idiomatic: For the rotation remainder, when increase applies, subtract from the divisor;

sentences.zh: 應損者，因餘：皆以乘率差，盈通法得一，加於通率，轉率乘之，通法約之，以朓減、朒加轉率，為定率。

translations.literal: where decrease is due, use the remainder as basis: in each case multiply by the rate difference, and when full of the universal method take one and add to the universal rate; multiply by the rotation rate and reduce by the universal method; with fast subtract and slow add to the rotation rate, obtaining the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: when decrease applies, use the remainder as basis: multiply by the rate difference, divide by the universal divisor and add to the universal rate; multiply by the rotation rate and reduce by the universal divisor; subtract for fast and add for slow to the rotation rate, obtaining the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以定率損益朓朒積，為定數。

translations.literal: Then with the fixed rate increase or decrease the fast-slow accumulation, obtaining the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed rate to adjust the anomalistic accumulation, yielding the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 其後無同率者，亦因前率。

translations.literal: Where there is no matching rate thereafter, likewise follow the prior rate.
translations.idiomatic: When no matching rate follows, proceed from the prior rate in the same way.

sentences.zh: 應益者，以通率為初數，半率差而減之；

translations.literal: Where increase is due, take the universal rate as the initial number and subtract half the rate difference;
translations.idiomatic: When increase applies, take the universal rate as the initial value and subtract half the rate difference;

translations.literal: where decrease is due, it is itself the universal rate.
translations.idiomatic: when decrease applies, the universal rate itself serves.

sentences.zh: 其損益入餘進退日，分為二日，隨餘初末，如法求之。

translations.literal: Where increase-decrease in the entry remainder advances or retreats the day, split the parts across two days and, according to initial or terminal remainder, seek by the method.
translations.idiomatic: When adjustment of the entry remainder carries or borrows a day, apportion the parts over two days and compute by initial or terminal remainder as the method requires.

translations.literal: What is obtained is together used to increase or decrease the rotation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Use the result together to adjust the rotation rate.

sentences.zh: 此術本出皇極曆，以究算術之微變。

translations.literal: This method originally comes from the Huangji calendar, to exhaust the subtle shifts of computational art.
translations.idiomatic: This procedure derives from the Huangji calendar, refining the subtle variations of computational astronomy.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交者，直以入餘乘損益率，如通法而一，以損益朓朒，為定數。

translations.literal: If it is not a new or full moon with an eclipse, directly multiply the entry remainder by the increase-decrease rate, as one per universal method, and with that increase or decrease fast-slow, obtaining the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: When new or full moon has no eclipse, multiply the entry remainder directly by the increase-decrease rate, divide by the universal divisor, and adjust fast-slow accordingly to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 七日：初數二千七百一，末數三百三十九。

translations.literal: Day seven: initial number 2,701, terminal number 339.

sentences.zh: 十四日：初數二千三百六十三，末數六百七十七。

translations.literal: Day fourteen: initial number 2,363, terminal number 677.

sentences.zh: 二十一日：初數二千二十四，末數千一十六。

translations.literal: Day twenty-one: initial number 2,024, terminal number 1,016.

sentences.zh: 二十八日：初數千六百八十六，末數千三百五十四。

translations.literal: Day twenty-eight: initial number 1,686, terminal number 1,354.

sentences.zh: 以四象約轉終，均得六日二千七百一分。

translations.literal: Reduce the rotation cycle by the four-image divisor; evenly obtain six days, 2,701 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the rotation cycle by the four-image divisor; each segment is six days, 2,701 parts.

sentences.zh: 就全數約為九分日之八。

translations.literal: Reduce the full number to approximate eight-ninths of a day.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the full count to approximate eight parts in nine of a day.

translations.literal: For each, subtract from the method; the remainder is the terminal number.
translations.idiomatic: For each segment, subtract from the divisor; the remainder is the terminal value.

sentences.zh: 乃四象馴變相加，各其所當之日初末數也。

translations.literal: Then add the four-image shifts in sequence, each its corresponding day’s initial and terminal numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the four-image transitions in order, yielding each corresponding day’s initial and terminal values.

sentences.zh: 視入轉餘，如初數已下者，加減損益，因循前率。

translations.literal: Inspect the entered rotation remainder: if below the initial number, increase or decrease by the prior rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the entered rotation remainder falls below the initial value, apply increase or decrease following the prior rate.

sentences.zh: 如初數以上，則反其衰，歸于後率云。

translations.literal: If above the initial number, reverse the decline and return to the posterior rate.
translations.idiomatic: If above the initial value, reverse the decline and revert to the posterior rate.

sentences.zh: 各置朔、弦、望大小餘，以入氣、入轉朓朒定數，朓減、朒加之，為定朔、弦、望大小餘。

translations.literal: For each, set the major and minor remainders of new, quarter, and full moon; with the fast-slow fixed numbers for entered qi and entered rotation, fast subtract and slow add, obtaining fixed major and minor remainders for new, quarter, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Set the major and minor remainders for each new, quarter, and full moon; apply the fixed fast-slow numbers for entered qi and rotation—subtract for fast, add for slow—to obtain the fixed syzygy remainders.

sentences.zh: 定朔日名與後朔同者，月大；

translations.literal: When the fixed new-moon day name matches the following new moon, the month is long;
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed new-moon day name matches the next new moon, the month is long;

translations.literal: when they differ, it is short;
translations.idiomatic: when they differ, it is short;

translations.literal: when there is no central qi, it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: when no central qi falls in the month, it is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 凡言夜半，皆起晨前子正之中。

translations.literal: Whenever speaking of midnight, all begin from the middle of early-morning zi before dawn.
translations.idiomatic: All references to midnight begin from true midnight at the start of zi before dawn.

sentences.zh: 若注曆，觀弦、望定小餘，不盈晨初餘數者，退一日。

translations.literal: If annotating the calendar, observe the fixed minor remainder at quarter and full moon; if it does not fill the early-morning initial remainder, retreat one day.
translations.idiomatic: In calendar annotation, if the fixed minor remainder at quarter or full moon does not reach the early-morning initial remainder, set the date back one day.

sentences.zh: 其望有交、起虧在晨初已前者，亦如之。

translations.literal: If at full moon there is an eclipse and the onset of waning is already before early morning, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies when a full-moon eclipse begins before early morning.

sentences.zh: 又月行九道遲疾，則有三大二小。

translations.literal: Again, the moon’s motion in the nine paths has fast and slow phases, hence there are three long and two short months.
translations.idiomatic: Because the moon’s nine-path motion varies in speed, months naturally run three long and two short.

sentences.zh: 以日行盈縮累增損之，則容有四大三小，理數然也。

translations.literal: Accumulating increase and decrease from the sun’s daily surplus and deficit, one may occasionally get four long and three short; the pattern of numbers allows this.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulative adjustment by the sun’s daily equation of time can occasionally yield four long and three short months; the arithmetic permits it.

sentences.zh: 若俯循常儀，當察加時早晚，隨其所近而進退之，使不過三大三小。

translations.literal: If one follows the ordinary rule in practice, one should inspect whether the hour-added time is early or late and advance or retreat accordingly, so as not to exceed three long and three short.
translations.idiomatic: In practice, inspect whether the hour-added time is early or late and adjust accordingly, keeping within three long and three short months.

sentences.zh: 其正月朔有交、加時正見者，消息前後一兩月，以定大小，令虧在晦、二。

translations.literal: If the first-month new moon has an eclipse and the hour-added time is exactly at visibility, shift the long-short determination a month or two before and after, fixing the size so that waning falls on the last or second day.
translations.idiomatic: When the first-month new moon has an eclipse at exact visibility, adjust long-short assignment a month or two on either side so that waning falls on the last or second day.

sentences.zh: 定朔、弦、望夜半日度各隨所直日度及餘分命之。

translations.literal: For each fixed new, quarter, and full moon at midnight, name the solar degree from the degree and remainder of the day reached.
translations.idiomatic: For each fixed syzygy at midnight, name the solar longitude from that day’s degree and remainder.

translations.literal: Then array the fixed new- and full-moon minor remainders and keep duplicates.
translations.idiomatic: Array the fixed new- and full-moon minor remainders and keep duplicate tallies.

sentences.zh: 以乘其日盈縮分，如通法而一，盈加、縮減其副。

translations.literal: Multiply by that day’s surplus-deficit fraction; as one per universal method; surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by that day’s equation of time, divide by the universal divisor, and add or subtract from the duplicate according to surplus or deficit.

sentences.zh: 以加夜半日度，各得加時日度。

translations.literal: Add to the midnight solar degree; each yields the hour-added solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the midnight solar longitude to obtain the hour-added solar degree for each.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔所交，冬在陰曆、夏在陽曆，月行青道；

translations.literal: For all syzygies at conjunction, when winter is in yin months and summer in yang months, the moon follows the green path;
translations.idiomatic: At syzygy, when winter falls in yin months and summer in yang months, the moon follows the green path;

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，當黃道東。

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path’s half-intersection lies in the spring-equinox lodge, east of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path’s half-intersection lies at the spring-equinox lodge, east of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，當黃道東南。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Spring lodge, southeast of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Spring lodge, southeast of the ecliptic.

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 冬在陽曆，夏在陰曆，月行白道；

translations.literal: When winter is in yang months and summer in yin months, the moon follows the white path;
translations.idiomatic: When winter is in yang months and summer in yin months, the moon follows the white path;

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，當黃道西。

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path’s half-intersection lies in the autumn-equinox lodge, west of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path’s half-intersection lies at the autumn-equinox lodge, west of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，白道半交在立秋之宿，當黃道西北。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Autumn lodge, northwest of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodge, northwest of the ecliptic.

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春在陽曆，秋在陰曆，月行朱道；

translations.literal: When spring is in yang months and autumn in yin months, the moon follows the vermilion path;
translations.idiomatic: When spring is in yang months and autumn in yin months, the moon follows the vermilion path;

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，朱道半交在夏至之宿，當黃道南。

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermilion path’s half-intersection lies in the summer-solstice lodge, south of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermilion path’s half-intersection lies at the summer-solstice lodge, south of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春、立秋後，朱道半交在立夏之宿，當黃道西南。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermilion path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Summer lodge, southwest of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermilion path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Summer lodge, southwest of the ecliptic.

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春在陰曆，秋在陽曆，月行黑道。

translations.literal: When spring is in yin months and autumn in yang months, the moon follows the black path.
translations.idiomatic: When spring is in yin months and autumn in yang months, the moon follows the black path.

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿，當黃道北。

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path’s half-intersection lies in the winter-solstice lodge, north of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path’s half-intersection lies at the winter-solstice lodge, north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春、立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，當黃道東北。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Winter lodge, northeast of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Winter lodge, northeast of the ecliptic.

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 四序離為八節，至陰陽之所交，皆與黃道相會，故月有九行。

translations.literal: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang cross, all meet the Yellow Path — hence the moon has nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons yield eight nodes; at each yin–yang crossing the moon meets the ecliptic — hence nine paths of lunar motion.

sentences.zh: 各視月交所入七十二候距交初中黃道日度，每五度為限，亦初數十二，每限減一，數終於四，乃一度強，依平。

translations.literal: For each, observe the Yellow Path solar degree at the initial and middle of the seventy-two hou from the moon’s conjunction entry; every five degrees is one band, again with initial count twelve, each band reduced by one until the count ends at four, then one degree slightly strong, follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: For each conjunction entry, take the ecliptic solar degree at the initial and middle of the seventy-two hou; every five degrees is one band, beginning at twelve and subtracting one per band until four, then one degree slightly strong—use the mean.

sentences.zh: 更從四起，每限增一，終於十二，而至半交，其去黃道六度。

translations.literal: Again begin from four; each band adds one until twelve, reaching half-intersection, six degrees from the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: Begin again at four; add one per band until twelve at half-intersection, six degrees from the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 又自十二，每限減一，數終於四，亦一度強，依平。

translations.literal: Again from twelve, each band reduced by one until the count ends at four, also one degree slightly strong, follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: From twelve again, subtract one per band until four, likewise one degree slightly strong—use the mean.

sentences.zh: 更從四起，每限增一，終於十二，復與日軌相會。

translations.literal: Again begin from four; each band adds one until twelve, again meeting the solar track.
translations.idiomatic: Begin at four again; add one per band until twelve, reuniting with the solar track.

sentences.zh: 各累計其數，以乘限度，二百四十而一，得度。

translations.literal: In each case accumulate the counts, multiply by the band-number, and as 240 to one obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the counts in order, multiply by the band index, and divide by 240 to obtain degrees.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，二十四除，為分，若以二十除之，則大分，以十二為母。

translations.literal: What does not fill, divide by twenty-four for parts; if divided by twenty, the major parts take twelve as denominator.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by twenty-four, gives parts; if divided by twenty instead, major parts use twelve as denominator.

translations.literal: This is the moon’s motion and Yellow Path difference number.
translations.idiomatic: This is the lunar ecliptic latitude difference.

sentences.zh: 距半交前後各九限，以差數為減；

translations.literal: For nine bands before and after half-intersection, use the difference as decrease;
translations.idiomatic: Within nine bands on either side of half-intersection, subtract the difference;

sentences.zh: 距正交前後各九限，以差數為加。

translations.literal: for nine bands before and after true conjunction, use the difference as increase.
translations.idiomatic: within nine bands on either side of true conjunction, add the difference.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入六度，單與黃道相較之數。

translations.literal: This increase and decrease shifts in and out by six degrees — the number compared solely with the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment shifts latitude by six degrees—the value compared directly with the ecliptic alone.

sentences.zh: 若較之赤道，則隨氣遷變不常。

translations.literal: Compared with the equator, it shifts with qi and is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the equator, it varies with the seasons and is not constant.

sentences.zh: 計去冬至、夏至以來候數，乘黃道所差，十八而一，為月行與赤道差數。

translations.literal: Count the hou from the Winter or Summer Solstice, multiply the ecliptic difference, and as eighteen to one obtain the moon’s motion and equator difference number.
translations.idiomatic: Count hou elapsed since the Winter or Summer Solstice, multiply the ecliptic difference, and divide by eighteen to obtain the lunar equatorial latitude difference.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，外為陽；

translations.literal: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;
translations.idiomatic: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰，外為陽。

translations.literal: for the moon, inside the Yellow Path is yin and outside is yang.
translations.idiomatic: for the moon, inside the ecliptic is yin and outside is yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行宿度，入春分交後行陰曆、秋分交後行陽曆，皆為同名。

translations.literal: Hence for the moon’s lodge motion, after entering the spring-equinox intersection it follows yin months and after the autumn-equinox intersection yang months — both are same name.
translations.idiomatic: Hence after the spring-equinox crossing the moon follows yin months, and after the autumn-equinox crossing yang months — both are same-named.

sentences.zh: 若入春分交後行陽曆、秋分交後行陰曆，皆為異名。

translations.literal: If after the spring-equinox intersection it follows yang months, or after the autumn-equinox intersection yin months, both are different name.
translations.idiomatic: If after the spring-equinox crossing it follows yang months, or after the autumn-equinox crossing yin months, both are differently named.

sentences.zh: 其在同名，以差數為加者，加之；

translations.literal: Where same name, where the difference is increase, add it;
translations.idiomatic: Under same name, where the difference is for increase, add it;

sentences.zh: 若在異名，以差數為加者，減之；

translations.literal: Where different name, where the difference is increase, subtract it;
translations.idiomatic: Under different name, where the difference is for increase, subtract it;

sentences.zh: 皆以增損黃道度，為九道定度。

translations.literal: In each case use this to increase or decrease the Yellow Path degree, obtaining the nine-path fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these rules to adjust ecliptic longitude and obtain the fixed nine-path degree.

sentences.zh: 各以中氣去經朔日算，加其入交汎，乃以減交終，得平交入中氣日算。

translations.literal: For each, with central qi subtract the count of days from mean new moon, add its entered conjunction general, then subtract from conjunction cycle to obtain the mean conjunction’s day-count within central qi.
translations.idiomatic: For each central qi, subtract days from mean new moon, add the entered conjunction general term, and subtract from the conjunction cycle to obtain the mean conjunction’s day-count within that qi.

sentences.zh: 滿三元之策去之，餘得入後節日算。

translations.literal: When full of the three-origin interval, remove it; the remainder is the day-count entering the following node.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full three-origin intervals; the remainder is the day-count entering the next node.

sentences.zh: 因求次交者，以交終加之，滿三元之策去之，得後平交入氣日算。

translations.literal: To seek the next conjunction, add the conjunction cycle; when full of the three-origin interval, remove it, obtaining the posterior mean conjunction’s day-count within qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next conjunction, add the conjunction cycle and cast out full three-origin intervals, yielding the next mean conjunction’s day-count within qi.

sentences.zh: 各以氣初先後數先加、後減之，得平交入定氣日算。

translations.literal: For each, with the qi’s initial prior-posterior numbers first add then subtract, obtaining the mean conjunction’s day-count within fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: For each qi, apply the initial prior-posterior numbers by addition then subtraction to obtain the mean conjunction’s day-count within fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 倍六爻乘之，三其小餘，辰法除而從之；

translations.literal: Double and multiply by six lines; triple the minor remainder and follow with chronogram division;
translations.idiomatic: Double and multiply by six lines; triple the minor remainder and divide by the chronogram divisor;

sentences.zh: 以乘其氣損益率，如定氣辰數而一；

translations.literal: multiply by its qi’s increase-decrease rate; as one per fixed-qi chronogram count;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by that qi’s increase-decrease rate and divide by the fixed-qi chronogram count;

sentences.zh: 所得以損益其氣朓朒積，為定數。

translations.literal: what is obtained is used to increase or decrease its qi fast-slow accumulation, as the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: use the result to adjust that qi’s anomalistic accumulation as the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 又置平交所入定氣餘，加其日夜半入轉餘，以乘其日損益率，滿通法而一，以損益其日朓朒積，交率乘之，交數而一，為定數。

translations.literal: Again set the mean conjunction’s remainder within fixed qi; add its day-and-night midnight entered-rotation remainder; multiply by that day’s increase-decrease rate; when full of the universal method take one and increase or decrease that day’s fast-slow accumulation; multiply by the conjunction rate and as one per conjunction number, as the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean conjunction’s remainder within fixed qi; add the day’s midnight rotation entry remainder; multiply by that day’s increase-decrease rate, divide by the universal divisor, and adjust that day’s anomalistic accumulation; multiply by the conjunction rate and divide by the conjunction number for the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 乃以入氣入轉朓朒定數，朓減、朒加平交入氣餘，滿若不足，進退日算，為正交入定氣日算。

translations.literal: Then with the entered-qi and entered-rotation fast-slow fixed numbers, fast subtract and slow add to the mean conjunction’s remainder within qi; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day-count, as the true conjunction’s day-count within fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed fast-slow numbers for entered qi and rotation—subtract for fast, add for slow—to the mean conjunction’s qi remainder; carry or borrow days to obtain the true conjunction’s day-count within fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 其入定氣餘，副之，乘其日盈縮分，滿通法而一，以盈加、縮減其副，以加其日夜半日度，得正交加時黃道日度。

translations.literal: For the remainder within fixed qi, keep a duplicate; multiply by that day’s surplus-deficit fraction; when full of the universal method take one; surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the duplicate; add to that day-and-night midnight solar degree, obtaining the true-conjunction hour-added Yellow Path solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Keep a duplicate of the remainder within fixed qi; multiply by that day’s equation of time, divide by the universal divisor, and add or subtract from the duplicate; add to that night’s midnight solar longitude to obtain the true-conjunction hour-added ecliptic degree.

sentences.zh: 以正交加時度餘減通法，餘以正交之宿距度所入限數乘之，為距前分。

translations.literal: Subtract the true-conjunction hour-added degree remainder from the universal method; multiply the remainder by the limit-number of the distance-degree entry at the true-conjunction lodge, as the pre-distance fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the true-conjunction hour-added degree remainder from the universal divisor; multiply the remainder by the band index for the true-conjunction lodge’s distance entry to obtain the pre-distance fraction.

sentences.zh: 置距度下月道與黃道差，以通法乘之，減去距前分，餘滿二百四十除，為定差。

translations.literal: Set the moon-path and Yellow Path difference below the distance degree; multiply by the universal method and subtract the pre-distance fraction; when the remainder fills 240, divide for the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the lunar ecliptic latitude difference for the distance band, multiply by the universal divisor, subtract the pre-distance fraction, and when the remainder fills 240 divide to obtain the fixed difference.

translations.literal: What does not fill, one retreat makes seconds.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not fill, retreat one place for seconds.

sentences.zh: 以定差及秒加黃道度、餘，仍計去冬至、夏至已來候數乘定差，十八而一；

translations.literal: With the fixed difference and seconds add to the Yellow Path degree and remainder; still count the hou from the Winter or Summer Solstice and multiply the fixed difference, as eighteen to one;
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed difference and seconds to the ecliptic degree and remainder; still count hou from the Winter or Summer Solstice, multiply the fixed difference, and divide by eighteen;

sentences.zh: 所得依名同異而加減之，滿若不足，進退其度，得正交加時月離九道宿度。

translations.literal: what is obtained, according to same or different name, is added or subtracted; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the degree, obtaining the true-conjunction hour-added moon’s departure in the nine-path lodges.
translations.idiomatic: apply the result according to same or different name; carry or borrow degrees to obtain the true-conjunction hour-added lunar nine-path lodge longitude.

sentences.zh: 各置定朔、弦、望加時日度，從九道循次相加。

translations.literal: For each, set the hour-added solar degree at fixed new, quarter, and full moon; add in sequence along the nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: Set the hour-added solar degree for each fixed syzygy and accumulate along the nine paths in sequence.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔加時，月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，是謂離象。

translations.literal: At syzygy hour-added time, the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree — this is called the departure image.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction hour-addition the moon lies hidden beneath the sun at the same longitude—the departure image.

sentences.zh: 先置朔、弦、望加時黃道日度，以正交加時所在黃道宿度減之；

translations.literal: First set the Yellow Path solar degree at the hour-added new, quarter, and full moon; subtract the Yellow Path lodge degree where the true conjunction hour-added time falls;
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic solar degree at hour-added new, quarter, or full moon; subtract the ecliptic lodge degree at true-conjunction hour-addition;

sentences.zh: 餘以加其正交九道宿度，命起正交宿度算外，即朔、弦、望加時所當九道宿度也。

translations.literal: add the remainder to the nine-path lodge degree at true conjunction; count outward from the true-conjunction lodge degree — that is the nine-path lodge degree at the hour-added new, quarter, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: add the remainder to the nine-path lodge at true conjunction; count outward from that lodge to obtain the nine-path longitude at hour-added syzygy.

sentences.zh: 其合朔加時，若非正交，則日在黃道，月在九道，各入宿度雖多少不同，考其去極，若應繩準。

translations.literal: At conjunction hour-added time, if it is not true conjunction, the sun is on the Yellow Path and the moon on the nine paths; although their entered lodge degrees differ in magnitude, examining their distance from the pole, they answer to the plumb line.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction hour-addition, if not true conjunction, the sun remains on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths; though lodge longitudes differ, their polar distances align to the plumb line.

sentences.zh: 故云：月行潛在日下，與太陽同度。

translations.literal: Hence it is said: the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree.
translations.idiomatic: Hence: the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same longitude.

sentences.zh: 以一象之度九十一、餘九百五十四、秒二十二半為上弦，兌象。

translations.literal: One image’s degrees: 91, remainder 954, seconds 22½ — upper quarter, Duì image.
translations.idiomatic: One image interval: 91°, remainder 954, 22½ seconds—first quarter, Duì ☱.

sentences.zh: 倍之，而與日衝，得望，坎象。

translations.literal: Double it and oppose the sun, obtaining full moon, Kǎn image.
translations.idiomatic: Double it and oppose the sun to obtain full moon, Kǎn ☵.

translations.literal: Triple it, obtaining last quarter, Zhèn image.
translations.idiomatic: Triple it to obtain last quarter, Zhèn ☳.

sentences.zh: 各以加其所當九道宿度，秒盈象統從餘，餘滿通法從度，得其日加時月度。

translations.literal: For each, add to the corresponding nine-path lodge degree; when seconds fill the image cycle follow the remainder, and when the remainder fills the universal method follow the degree, obtaining that day’s hour-added lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add each to the corresponding nine-path lodge; carry seconds into the image cycle and remainder into degrees via the universal divisor to obtain that day’s hour-added lunar longitude.

sentences.zh: 綜五位成數四十，以約度餘，為分。

translations.literal: The five positions together make the number forty; reduce the degree remainder thereby for parts.
translations.idiomatic: The five positions sum to forty; reduce the degree remainder thereby for parts.

translations.literal: What does not exhaust becomes minor parts.

sentences.zh: 視經朔夜半入轉，若定朔大餘有進退者，亦加減轉日。

translations.literal: Inspect midnight entered rotation at mean new moon; if the fixed new-moon major remainder has advance or retreat, likewise add or subtract the rotation day.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect midnight rotation entry at mean new moon; if the fixed new-moon major remainder advances or retreats, adjust the rotation day likewise.

translations.literal: Otherwise follow mean new moon as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise take mean new moon as the fixed value.

translations.literal: Accumulate by adding one day to obtain the next day.
translations.idiomatic: Add one day at each step to obtain the next day.

sentences.zh: 各以夜半入轉餘乘列衰，如通法而一；

translations.literal: For each, multiply midnight entered-rotation remainder by the column decline; as one per universal method;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each midnight rotation entry remainder by the column decline and divide by the universal divisor;

sentences.zh: 所得以進加、退減其日轉分，為月轉定分。

translations.literal: what is obtained is used to advance-add or retreat-subtract that day’s rotation parts, as the moon’s rotation fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: use the result to advance or retreat that day’s rotation parts, yielding the lunar rotation fixed parts.

translations.literal: When full of the rotation method, that makes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the rotation divisor, they become degrees.

sentences.zh: 視定朔、弦、望夜半入轉，各半列衰以減轉分。

translations.literal: Inspect midnight entered rotation at fixed new, quarter, and full moon; for each halve the column decline to subtract from rotation parts.
translations.idiomatic: At fixed syzygy midnight rotation entry, halve the column decline and subtract from rotation parts.

sentences.zh: 退者，定餘乘衰，以通法除，幷衰而半之；

translations.literal: If retreating, multiply the fixed remainder by the decline, divide by the universal method, and halve together with the decline;
translations.idiomatic: If retreating, multiply the fixed remainder by the decline, divide by the universal divisor, and halve together with the decline;

sentences.zh: 進者，半餘乘衰，亦以通法除：皆加所減。

translations.literal: if advancing, halve the remainder, multiply by the decline, likewise divide by the universal method: in each case add to what was subtracted.
translations.idiomatic: if advancing, halve the remainder, multiply by the decline, divide by the universal divisor likewise, and add to the amount subtracted.

sentences.zh: 乃以定餘乘之，盈通法得一，以減加時月度，為夜半月度。

translations.literal: Then multiply by the fixed remainder; when full of the universal method take one and subtract from the hour-added lunar degree, as the midnight lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the fixed remainder; divide by the universal divisor and subtract from the hour-added lunar degree to obtain midnight lunar longitude.

sentences.zh: 各以每日轉定分累加之，得次日。

translations.literal: Accumulate by adding the daily rotation fixed parts each day to obtain the next day.
translations.idiomatic: Add the daily rotation fixed parts at each step to obtain the next day.

sentences.zh: 若以入轉定分，乘其日夜漏，倍百刻除，為晨分。

translations.literal: If with entered rotation fixed parts one multiplies the day-and-night clepsydra, doubling the hundred marks for division, that makes dawn parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the entered rotation fixed parts by the day-night clepsydra and divide by double the hundred marks for dawn parts.

translations.literal: Subtract from rotation fixed parts; the remainder is dusk parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the rotation fixed parts; the remainder is dusk parts.

sentences.zh: 望前以昏、望後以晨加夜半度，各得晨昏月。

translations.literal: Before full moon add dusk, after full moon add dawn to the midnight degree; each yields dawn and dusk moon.
translations.idiomatic: Before full moon add dusk parts, after full moon add dawn parts to midnight longitude to obtain dawn and dusk lunar positions.
Initial bend rate: 20, terminal stretch rate: 7

translations.literal: Initial stretch 13, terminal bend enters thereafter
translations.idiomatic: Initial stretch rate: 13, terminal bend rate enters thereafter

sentences.zh: 各視每日夜半入陰陽曆交日數，以其下屈伸積，月道與黃道同名者，加之；

translations.literal: For each, observe the yin-yang month intersection-day number at daily midnight; with the bend-stretch accumulation below it, where the moon-path and Yellow Path are same name, add it;
translations.idiomatic: For each day, take the yin-yang month intersection-day count at midnight; where the moon-path and ecliptic are same-named, add the bend-stretch accumulation below;

sentences.zh: 各以加減每日晨昏黃道月度，為入宿定度及分。

translations.literal: In each case add or subtract to the daily dawn and dusk Yellow Path lunar degree, as the entered-lodge fixed degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these adjustments to each day’s dawn and dusk ecliptic lunar longitudes to obtain fixed lodge degrees and parts.
